blocks.text: This page tracks the West Vancouver MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $2,244,700 for a typical home, down 7.4% over twelve months.
West Vancouver benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical West Vancouver home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $2,244,700 in September 2026. That is little changed at −1.1% on the month, down 3.3% over three months, down 6.4% over six months and down 7.4% over the year. Over three years it is down 15.0%, and over five years down 15.8%.
The weakest one-year move in West Vancouver was for a detached home homes at −9.9%; the strongest was an apartment at −5.7%.
The board reports no townhouse benchmark for West Vancouver. The gap between a detached home ($2,822,900) and an apartment ($1,097,300) is $1,725,600.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,075,900, West Vancouver is 108.6% above. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.5% against down 7.4% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, West Vancouver ranks 1 by all-home benchmark, with Bowen Island below it at $1,405,400.

Detached homes in West Vancouver: benchmark $2,822,900, little changed at −0.9% in a month, down 3.6% in three months, down 8.8% in six months, down 9.9% in a year, down 13.4% in three years and down 11.3% in five. That is 58.2% above the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,784,700).

Apartment homes in West Vancouver: benchmark $1,097,300, down 2.2% in a month, down 4.3% in three months, little changed at −1.3% in six months, down 5.7% in a year, down 17.0% in three years and down 7.9% in five. That is 60.8% above the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($682,500).

blocks.text: What the West Vancouver figure is
The $2,244,700 West Vancouver figure is a modelled price for a typical home, not a median, and it comes from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® for September 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in West Vancouver?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical West Vancouver home was $2,244,700, with detached at $2,822,900.

faq.q: Are West Vancouver home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: West Vancouver is down 7.4% over twelve months and down 3.3% over three months.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
